newsitem.title: CHINA: CHIWAN PETROLEUM INTERIM NET 24 MLN YUAN.
newsitem.headline: CHIWAN PETROLEUM INTERIM NET 24 MLN YUAN.

text.p: Shenzhen Chiwan Petroleum Supply Base Co Ltd reaped net profits of 24.11 million yuan in the first half of 1997, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said on Thursday.
The company's per share net was 0.10 yuan and its sales reached 48.47 million yuan in the first half, the exchange said in a notice issued after the stock market closed.
It gave no comparative figures and did not say whether the results were based on international or Chinese accounting standards.
Trading in the firm's foreign currency B shares would be suspended on Friday morning for the announcement and would resume in the afternoon, the exchange said.

The company, which provides logistical services for foreign firms that explore for oil in the South China Sea, posted net profits of 26.95 million yuan, or 0.12 yuan per share, on sales of 44.64 million yuan for January-June 1996 under Chinese accounting standards.
